$ commit-hub-files.sh only-message
[exit 1]
--- stdout
--- stderr
用法: commit-hub-files.sh "<message>" <path>...

$ commit-hub-files.sh m hub.json todo.md
[exit 0]
--- stdout
commit-hub-files: todo.md 不是 config(data 不進 git),略過
commit-hub-files: <TMP>/config 不是 git repo,不 commit
--- stderr

$ commit-hub-files.sh m hub.json todo.md
[exit 0]
--- stdout
commit-hub-files: todo.md 不是 config(data 不進 git),略過
commit-hub-files: 已 commit+push:hub.json
--- stderr

$ commit-hub-files.sh m hub.json
[exit 0]
--- stdout
commit-hub-files: hub.json 沒有變化,不 commit
--- stderr

$ commit-hub-files.sh m nope.txt nope2.txt
[exit 0]
--- stdout
commit-hub-files: nope.txt nope2.txt 都不存在,不 commit
--- stderr
